<!--
  The simple locations (model locations@1): the heading, a description, the offices as a list (the name, the
  address) and one picture (a map or a place). Axes: media (start: the picture before the copy from md up, end:
  after it).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { LocationItem } from "./locations-simple.types";

export type LocationsSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  image?: string;
  imageAlt: string;
  imageSrcset?: string;
  items: LocationItem[];
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  media?: "start" | "end";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  description = "",
  image = "",
  imageAlt,
  imageSrcset = "",
  items,
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "start",
  media = "start",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<LocationsSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const itemsAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
  : "items-start"
);
const selfAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
  : ""
);
const pictureClass = computed(() => ((media as string) === "start") ? "md:order-first" : "");
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="locations-simple"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Box class="grid grid-cols-1 items-center gap-12 md:grid-cols-2">
        <Stack gap="8" align="stretch">
          <Stack gap="4" :align="column" :class="cn('max-w-2xl', selfAlign)">
            <Title :as="level" size="3xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('tracking-tight', textAlign)" :id="titleId">
              {{ title }}
            </Title>
            <Text v-if="description" size="base" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
              {{ description }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <List tag="ul" :class="cn('m-0 w-full list-none p-0', 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2')">
            <ListItem v-for="l in items" :key="l.id" :class="cn('flex flex-col gap-2', itemsAlign)" data-slot="location">
              <Title :as="(level + 1)" size="base" weight="semibold" :class="textAlign">
                {{ l.title }}
              </Title>
              <Text v-if="l.description" size="sm" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
                {{ l.description }}
              </Text>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
        </Stack>
        <MediaFrame :alt="imageAlt" :src="image" :srcset="imageSrcset" ratio="1/1" :class="pictureClass" />
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
